nom: Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum

avis.texte: I use it 3 or 4 times a week and noticed my skin is much smoother and brighter, a very good product.

I wanted this because I have PCOS and wanted to get away from the $100+ options, so I was looking around. that was on me and I should've looked at it better. what I will say what didn't work for me will be amazing for others. it is so gentle that if you have issues with retinol it may be something good to try for you. it does smell quite nice too. I did notice that instantly. since the package doesn't list it, it is only .3% retinol from what I can find if that helps.

I do see a little bit of change in my wrinkles and fine lines on my forehead. I have them pretty bad so after seven days of use, they seem to be a little bit better. I would probably say the texture of my skin has not changed . But it definitely has radiance. It looks more youthful and plump and shiny than it did before I used it . So it definitely made my skin look younger and more plump and filled in, but it didn't change much of the texture.. it's not a sticky formula. It goes on smooth and light and soak in really fast so your face is an oily or sticky after you use it which is nice. It comes in Good packaging with good directions and good information about the product and what it does and what to be careful about in the sun whenever you're using this type of chemical on your face, I would say that their claims are true that they make on their packaging on their marketing materials because it does make you look younger visibly younger within that time period.
Overall I like this serum. It helps with diminishing my fine lines and wrinkles but I can't use it near my eye area because it's too strong to use there.

This is an excellent product for aging skin. Very gentle, non greasy and light weight. Compared to other products I have used, I prefer this serum over capsules. Not only is this affordable it perfect for daily use.

This retinol serum is a perfect addition for skin care routine. It is very gentle, perfect for beginners or pro retinol users. I have generally normal skin sometimes leaning a little on the dry side. It did not cause any irritation or dryness. It's very easy to apply and absorbs quickly, not just staying at surface level. In a short period I noticed fine lines appearing less visible. I love neutrogena products!

Overall, I like using this serum. The consistency is nice -- it's medium thickness for a serum, so thicker than water but more runny than lotion. It absorbs very quickly and only takes a minute to dry down. I did not experience any dryness or irritation while applying it, but I did always put a moisturizer on over top of it. The only thing I wasn't a huge fan of is the dropper applicator. I don't like using droppers -- I find them to be a little messy at times, and I also sometimes will forget to fully screw the top back on and end up knocking it over at some point in time. For this particular serum too, it doesn't seem like there is a good reason to put it in a dropper bottle. I think it's thick enough to put in a pump container, or maybe even a tube that had a top which restricted the amount of product that comes out at once. Overall though, decent looking packaging and nice serum that is easy on the skin.
I'm surprised at the quality of this retinol serum, it rivals more expensive brands in quality and definitely is a good value for the size and cost. Will be purchasing.

Now that I've hit my mid 30's, I've noticed that my skin is looking duller than normal and is losing a lot of glow and moisture. After using the Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinal Renewal Serum every night for around a month, I've noticed so many different improvements in my skin. First and foremost, my skin looks and feels plumper and has helped to slightly fade some fine lines I was getting around my eyes. My skin looks overall healthier, smoother and more even-toned. I love how easy this is to incorporate into my skincare routine and I haven't experienced any negative side effects from using this serum. I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to rewind the clock a few years!

Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is a lightweight serum that packs a punch. I have been using it pm only for now and a small amount goes a long way. It spreads easily and absorbs easily. I feel that my skin tone feels a bit smoother in the past week since I started applying it. I love the feel of the product and how it is impacting the skin texture. Neutrogena creates great products and I love this one.
Just a few drops a day gave my skin a youthful glow. My skin was noticeably firmer and perky. It blended into my skin and didn't leave a sticky residue.

Neutrogena retinol renewal serum is a great way to introduce retinol to the skincare routine. This is really lightweight and mild retinol serum. As long as you follow the instructions and use SPF. I did have not a great experience with retinol before. Flaking, skin irritation. But this room works differently. It did not give me any uncomfortable feelings, yet I saw the results. I just turned 40 this year and one to use in retinol in my skincare more regularly. This serum improved the look of my pores and made skin more glowy. I'm really happy with this serum and will definitely be using it more.

It has a dispenser dropper to get the serum, I like this design rather than a tube or an open jar, so the serum won't be contaminated by fingers easily. After applying it for a week, my skin looks smoother and moisturized, as compared to retinol serum from other brand which dried my skin.

This was easy to dispense and apply. It isn't too strong for my skin which is nice, as some retinol can be drying when you use it. There is no noticeable scent, so I also like that about it. I will keep using it as retinol is a long game ingredient. The consistency is good, it's not too runny, and not to thick.

I've noticed subtle improvements in my skin since adding this serum to my routine. My fine lines are a little less pronounced and I'm curious to see how they continue to improve with use. The formula is very gentle and I didn't have any reactions to using it.

I trust Neutrogena for quality skin care so I was especially excited to try this retinol serum. I have used retinol before. This serum did not irritate my skin at all. I like the texture and consistency of the serum as well. It has a light pleasant scent.

I love the Neutrogena, rapid wrinkle repair retinol renewal serum. This product is easy to apply and non-messy with the dropper. I get the perfect amount I need. It is not messy to use. It is general on my skin and I have not had any adverse reactions . This serum visibly reduced my wrinkles around my eyes within the first week. I also did notice it seemed to reduce the visibility of my pores on my nose. I love this product is not greasy or sticky. It does increase firmness of my face and neck. This is my new go to.

I really enjoy Neutrogena products and I love retinol, so this is a perfect combination. The serum is easily absorbed and in the morning my face feels soft. The retinol is very gentle and I had no sensitivity issues. My only suggestion would be to reduce the amount of fragrance. I found it too strong to apply around my eyes and that's where I need it the most. As long as you don't mind a strong fragrance, this is an excellent retinol serum and with continued use I expect my skin to get even softer.

I have used this serum for several days and it lightweight and hydrating. There is a light clean scent. It absorbs quickly into my skin and doesnt leave a residue. A couple of drops covers my fave and neck. I layered it with a facial spf each day. It seems to effectively improve my skin texture.

This retinol is easy to use and it was gentle on my skin, I didn't experience any sensitivity or redness after using it. My skin looks smoother and healthy after using it, though I haven't really seen a difference in wrinkles. I like the dropper applicator, it's easy to just place a few drops around where I want it.
I've been using prescription retinol for a while and wanted to try this instead to save a little money. After first use it dried my skin out so bad and made my cheeks red.

I like how smooth the texture of the cream is, it's not too heavy or thin. I especially like how quick it absorbed, so essentially no wait time after applying. I like using fragrance free products to reduce any sensitivity, this one had a slight smell to it but it was tolerable. I don't have fine lines or wrinkles but I use this as a preventative measure.

I generally just love Neutrogena products and this one does not disappoint! I've been using it nightly, my skin is glowing and feels refreshed every morning. It doesn't irritate my skin. I will keep using and keep repurchasing!

As a big fan of Neutrogena skincare, I was excited to try Retinol Renewal Serum. I used this milky serum in the evening after cleansing. It's got a nice silky texture that felt soothing and nourishing on my skin. After using for a fair amount of time I've noticed my skin texture and tone already noticeably improving to look clearer, even, and smoother. I'm at the age where I've already got fine lines, so I'm super excited to see how this works in the long run on those areas. Overall, my pores are seeming less noticeable and my skin just has a nice glow that I haven't noticed in a while. I recommend the Neutrogena Retinol Renewal Serum if you're looking to improve skin appearance and help reduce fine lines!

avis.titre: an easy to use retinol serum
avis.texte: I am pleased with this retinol serum after having used it for a week. I can't say that I see immediate results, but it is easy to use, not greasy, absorbs well and doesn't have a harsh chemical smell. It has not irritated my face the way that some prescription formulas have done.

avis.titre: Didn't work for my skin type
avis.texte: I am a user of retinol so was excited to try this version from neutrogena. I have hormonal acne along my jawlines occasionally but have been less mild of late. I I produced this product and it totally broke me out on my jawlines and chin. I'm not sure if others were purging or this was too strong for my skin but not a product id recommend as a result.

avis.titre: Good product from a brand I love & trust
avis.texte: This serum is wonderful! I love Neutrogena and I always have had great experiences with all of their products. This Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum did not disappoint! Ive been using it for a few weeks now and my pores are diminishing. My wrinkles and fine lines are still there however they look smoother and less harsh. My skin feels so soft and already a little firmer. I cant wait to see what it does after a month of use. I will continue using this serum daily and i would recommend it to anyones skin care routine. Im 51 and my only regret is that I didn't start a skincare routine sooner. It is never too early to use a good serum and moisturizer!

I've been using this Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum for one week. The formula has a milky texture that spreads easily. I like how quickly it absorbs and visibly nourishes the skin. So far after a few days my skin looks slightly softer. I don't know about the wrinkle removing effects yet, I need more time to see if it helps with wrinkles.

The rapid wrinkle repair Neutrogena renewal serum has really improved my fines lines around my eyes and mouth. It has made my face more firmer. I would recommend this product to anyone looking for a good serum for and repairs for your face.

Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is a lightweight retinol serum that I have found works great!! After 1 week of use I noticed a difference and by week 2 a huge difference in my small lines and wrinkles on my face. The retinol and aantioxidant formula also visibly improved the look and feel of the texture of my skin and made it look more radiant. I highly recommend using the Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum with the other Neutrogena products for more radiant and beautiful skin.

avis.titre: Great retinol for banishing those wrinkl
avis.texte: I really like how easy this was to apply to my skin. It really helped with my fine lines on my forehead and smiles lines. Very hydrating did not dry out my skin once! I absolutely will purchase this once this runs out!

I've been using this serum for approximately two weeks and am pleased with the initial results; I'll be incorporating this product into my routine. The formula is lightweight, has a pleasant scent, absorbs nicely into my skin, and the dropper bottle is great for dispensing the necessary small amount. I've used this product only at night as retinol and the Arizona sun does not mix.

This is a nice face serum. This one really soaks in nicely, it doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky, it leaves it feeling soft. I did feel that it takes more serum than I thought it would though. I also like how it didn't burn or sting at all. So far my skin is really liking this serum.

I love this product. I've been using it every morning and it feels so lightweight and blends right into my skin. I've only been using it a month but it's visibly changing my face for the younger. The smell is also light and pleasant. I would highly recommend.

I have used the Retinol Renewal Serum for a couple weeks now, and I have noticed fewer wrinkles on my forehead and under my eyes. My skin looks smoother and feels softer. I will definitely enjoy continuing to use this product for greater results!

The Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is a reliable, beginner-friendly retinol that delivers visible results with minimal irritation. It's an excellent choice for someone who wants to start incorporating retinol into their routine or is looking for a lightweight, effective anti-aging serum at a reasonable price. I've been using other retinol products and this is gentle, yet effective for early stage wrinkle solutions.

Left my skin feeling smoother than before the test. Absorbs well into the skin and no bad reactions from daily use. Hoping that with continued use my fine lines and uneven skin tone will improve. Will definitely buy again if I see continued results.

I used this at bedtime daily for about 2 weeks and did start to notice a difference in the puffiness and fine lines below my eyes! It does cause some dryness so you have to be sure to wear a good moisturizer and can cause sun sensitivity, so make sure to wear a good facial sunscreen. I will keep using to see if the results continue to get better with time but thus far would highly recommend. Easy to apply with fingertips and a little goes a long way.

This Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is one of my favorite ways to add anti-aging capabilities to my nightly skincare routine. This serum is lightweight and non-sticky. It glides easily over the skin and layers nicely under a moisturizer. I noticed a reduction in fine lines within a week of using this product. I would recommend this product to others.

I was very surprised to see results so soon! I can tell my fine lines are finer, and the texture of my skin is smooth and bright. I get a little worried using retinol during summer when I am outside a lot, but I used sunscreen and all was well. I would recommend this product!

I immediately loved this serum. My face doesn't react great to fragrances, but this one doesn't have a very strong fragrance at all. It's REALLY light and the faint smell it does have, smells great! I love the feel of the serum itself. It isn't sticky at all and absorbs great! The directions do say to put it around the eyes, so I'm assuming it's safe enough to do so. I've been doing it and it's fine. For the record, the skin around my eyes is sensitive, but this doesn't irritate it. I put this on my neck as well. I love it!

This product feel so nice. I had been using before bed every other night. It absorbs very nicely into the skin and doesn't leave the skin feeling sticky at all. Makes my skin look a little brighter. I haven't used long enough to see big results but I will continue to use.

I am not that old but I'm not that young either. I was so excited when I was sent this product to test & review. Honestly, A+ did not irritate my skin & I started to see results after using it as directed on the back. I'm so impressed with the results & I will be recommending it.

I liked how the product was easy to use. I didn't experience any of the redness during use. I noticed the fine lines became less noticable after using for a few weeks. I would continue to use Neutrogena in place of other retinol products. The directions were easy to follow and the size of the bottle was generous at 1 fl oz.

This serum glides onto my skin easily and doesn't irritate my face like some other varieties on the market. My face feels hydrated, and slightly more youthful, too. Love that you don't have to spend and arm and a leg on this treatment.

I really like this Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum from Neutrogena. Most of the retinol serums I've tried are liquid like so I was excited to see one that was more of a cream base. I've been using for two weeks and can see improvements so excited to see the results after a few months.

I was surprised with the effectiveness of Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum. I used this at night, and follow through with a light moisturizer. No harsh, tightening feeling. Wrinkles became a bit less noticeable. Skin became a bit smoother. Biggest downside was that this product did make my skin purge. My chin completely broke out in acne. It was horrible. BUT that's also a sign that the retinol is working, bringing to the surface of all underlying impurities. Just be warned.

I can defiantly recommend that everyone try Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum. I have only been using it for about 2 weeks now and I can already feel the difference in my skin. It's smooth and plump. Retinol reduces wrinkles and helps prevent them as well, so I think this a great product for anyone to use. I didn't experience any irritation with this product.

I'm usually a big fan of Neutrogena products but as much as I like this rapid wrinkle repair retinol renewal serum I have to take stars off for the fragrance. I don't mind some fragrance in skincare but this is very perfumey. The serum itself has a nice medium light consistency and a smooth texture. It absorbs easily and feels nice on my skin, almost weightless once it's absorbed. I do think that my skin feels softer and a little more even textured. It didn't cause any irritation or dryness/flaking like some retinol products do. I like that it has an added 'soothing complex', I think that it did help to combat any irritation I may otherwise have gotten. I haven't seen any major changes in my fine lines or skin firmness yet. I know that, despite the claims of results in a few weeks, it can take quite a while of consistent usage to see real results. Overall I think it's a good, relatively affordable option for someone wanting to try a gentle retinol who doesn't mind fragrance.

This serum smelled great and applied like a dream. It was easier to apply than other retinols I've tried, and I like that it didn't make my skin feel greasy. My skin also feels softer after using it, but I didn't notice a difference in fine lines.

Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is a reasonably priced must have! It feels nice on the skin, with a lightweight consistency that absorbs quickly. The scent is subtle and fades away fast. Retinol can sometimes cause irritation, especially for those with sensitive skin but I did not have issues. This serum contains glycerin and hyaluronic acid, which may provide a subtle more comfortable and hydrating experience. I began an introduction that was slow when adding this serum. The serum is a good and affordable option for those seeking to reduce fine lines, wrinkles or enhance skin's texture. It can lead to a healthier, more radiant complexion without any issues.

Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum has been pretty good to my skin and face! It's been 7 days and I'm seeing a little difference but not too much yet, however, I'm not giving up on it! It's working, just slowly. This product improves the look of fine lines, wrinkles, pores, texture and firmness. It is a nice, creamy texture and rubs in well. It does not burn my skin or give me any negative side effects. It doesn't take a large amount to get good coverage either! I can't wait to see the end results after using this daily. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I love the lightweight texture of this Neutrogena Retinol Renewal Serum. So silky, milky texture is perfect, not too watery. Feels so luxury! Applies to the skin so smoothly and absorbs really fast without an oilyness look. It looks so natural on the skin and wears comfortable. The bottle is big, and you just need 3 drops. This is a daily serum and works well for under makeup. Just don't forget to use SPF. I like how my skin gets softer after just a week of using it. And I did see the improvements in my fine lines, getting smoother and less visible. Also, this serum is good for acne prone skin, no irritatings. The product without parapens, mineral oil, and dyes.

This is a very nice serum. It glides on nicely and soaks in quickly, without any stickiness or residue. I use this each morning, followed by sunscreen and my makeup. I find that the serum layers well with the other steps in my skincare routine. I have noticed that the serum has definitely brightened my complexion. I haven't seen a huge difference yet in fine lines and wrinkles, but look forward to continuing to use it to see long term effects.

Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkler Repair is a very soft serum that you massage on your face and neck. It absorbs quickly into your skin and my skin feels soft. I focused more around my eyes, but I did cover my entire face and neck and after 2 weeks, I'm seeing a difference. My wrinkles aren't as prominent as they once were and im excited that my wrinkles are diminishing and will continue to use this along with other products from Neutrogena.

Lightweight texture, spreads quite easily and it seems to work well. I can see the effect after a week of daily using it and would recommend for those looking for an effective retinol serum (as I tried many retinol products and not all of them actually work)

I really like this retinol serum. It goes on super lightweight and is not thick or greasy at all. It looks opaque at first but applies translucent and absorbs quickly into the skin. The dropper works well and makes it easy to control how much you use. I didn't experience any burning or irritation, and there's no filmy residue left behind. Overall, it's a great starter retinol if you're just getting into it, and very easy to incorporate in your skincare routine; even my husband started to try!

Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is a little bottle of magic wrinkle erase. The serum is lightweight as promised and goes on smoothly. I find that it works magic on my chest area and neck. I am a side sleeper and have more wrinkles than I should, and this has worked amazingly. It has also visibly improved the lines on my forehead and around my eyes. I plan to continue with daily usage.

This serum is great! It has a pleasant smell and absorbed quickly, my skin has never looked better! Lightweight, non greasy formula made it easy to layer under moisturizer with makeup. This serum left my face feeling nourished, plump and fresh!

avis.titre: I can already see and feel it working
avis.texte: It's only been a week and I can already see and feel this serum working. My nose pores seem smaller and my cheeks feel softer. The serum is milky and absorbs into my skin almost instantly. This is a high quality product and I will continue to use it.

I'm liking this light retinol serum. It is an easy way to add retinol to your daily routine using the dropper bottle. It is lightly hydrating and leaves skin feeling supple. The addition of a soothing complex and glycerin is great for the powerful retinol.

avis.titre: Very good for a drugstore product
avis.texte: I am a fan of Neutrogena in general. I think they make a high quality product range that's somewhat affordable. This product feels like a mid-weight serum. It's substantial but it absorbs well without leaving a "coated" feeling. It leaves your skin feeling smooth without too much stickiness. I can't really comment on effectiveness because any retinol product needs time to produce results. I did take away one star only because it is scented. Not too strong, but the scent does stay for a significant amount of time

I absolutely love the Neutrogena Retinol Renewal Serum. It really works to make my skin look softer and smoother. Its so easy to apply and spread on my skin. It dries quickly and doesn't leave a sticky or tacky feeling. My skin feels hydrated all day. It instantly gives me a subtle glow as well.

I've been using the Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum for almost 2 weeks now, and I can definitely see a difference in my skin. It feels smoother and looks a bit more even-toned, especially around my forehead and smile lines. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feeling, which I really appreciate since I have combination skin. There was a tiny bit of dryness the first few nights I used it, but once I paired it with a good moisturizer, that went away. It has a light scent but nothing overpowering.

I've been using the Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum for a bit now. It has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any sticky residue. I love how hydrating it feels on my skin—definitely not drying like some other retinol products I've tried. It also has a very light, pleasant scent that doesn't linger, which I appreciate. Application is easy and smooth, and it layers well with my other skincare products. As for visible improvements in fine lines or texture, I haven't noticed a dramatic change just yet, but I understand that retinol can take a bit longer for those kinds of results to show. So far, no irritation, which is a big plus. Overall, I'm happy with how it feels and performs as part of my routine and I'm looking forward to seeing more results with continued use.

This serum is the REAL deal! It glides on so well, dries quickly, and leaves my face feeling so soft! I could immediately feel a tightening around my eyes, which was exciting! After using it for over a week, I can definitely tell a difference in my fine lines around my eyes, my forehead, and around my mouth. I would definitely purchase this again to keep in my routine and would recommend to friends and family!

Neutrogena's Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol has quickly become a staple in my nighttime routine! The easy to use dispenser makes application simple and mess free. If you're new to retinol, I recommend starting slowly every other night at first to allow your skin to adjust. And don't forget to use sunscreen during the day since retinol can make skin more sensitive to the sun. After just a week of use, I noticed a visible improvement in fine lines and wrinkles. My skin feels firmer, smoother, and the texture is noticeably more refined. I'm excited to see continued results, especially with pore refinement over the coming weeks. A great option for anyone looking to refresh their skin!
This product was easy to apply, and not messy. Once applied the product absorbed quickly. My skin felt soft and moisturized. I received this product for free for testing purposes.
This serum is very hydrating while providing the benefits of retinol. It's gentle enough to use daily and has incorporated well into my skincare routine. Would recommend!

I tried the Neutrogena Retinol Renewal serum. I am in my mid thirties and have used Retinol for the last decade. This serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly. It assist to remove fine lines around my eyes and forehead.

I love Neutrogena products, and this one didn't disappoint, either. It makes my skin look more plump and radiant. It's fast absorbing and non-greasy, which is great in summer. I'll definitely continue using it to see more long-term benefits from retinol.

I was really impressed with this product because it said that you could also use it in your eye area, which I was careful not to get it in my eye, but very careful to get it around my eye and it was very effective. Liked it very much. I've always liked this line of Stuff, but I'm even more impressed. After I wash my face, I just smooth on over my entire face, including my eye area and I allowed it to enjoy which was quick then I followed with my moisturizer sunscreen. Absolutely love that I would highly recommend it for anybody.

I have wanted to try something from this Rapid Wrinkle Repair line for a while, and I'm so thrilled with the results! I have a current face care regime that includes retinol. The results in the pictures are from only changing my current retinol to the new Retinol Renewal Serum. I have sun damage from tanning in my 20s on my face especially with dark spots along my cheek bones. After using for 14 days, I can see some smoothing of the deeper wrinkles, a reduction in size of my pores, a lightening of the spots along my cheek bones and the overall texture and tone has greatly improved. The serum is like a light lotion and absorbs quickly, I had no irritation, and it has a light fragrance but smells great! This retinol performs better than more expensive brands that I have tried. If you are not quite happy with your current retinol results and are looking for more or are just starting out, I recommend trying because it is such an affordable option.

The Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum made my skin feel so soft and look so smooth. It was safe and non irritating for my pale, sensitive skin. I slowly incorporated it into my daily regimen and loved the results.

I absolutely loved testing this Retinol Renewal serum! It was gentle, but still worked wonders! I was very pleased with how nicely it applied and a little bit went a long way!! I would highly recommend trying this serum.

I was very pleased with the product. It applied smoothly and did not irritate my skin like some retinol products I have tried in the past. I used this nightly and noticed my skin was smooth in the morning. The lines and wrinkles looked a little softer the day after using.
This was a nice product as it didn't irritate my skin and cause any major dryness. However I haven't seen any changes to my skin yet but it might be too early to see them

I started out every other day with the Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum as I am somewhat of a retinol beginner. I made sure to apply soothing moisturizers after to help keep my skin happy though the serum also contains a soothing complex. The formula with retinol and antioxidant spreads easily and absorbs fast with no leftover residue or tackiness. No skin irritation or reactions, so this seems to be a fairly gentle formula.

I've only been using it a little over a week and can tell a small difference in my fine lines. Which it says it could take up to 4 weeks, so it's on track. My skin feels really smooth and it doesn't dry my skin out like other retinol products have before.

I enjoyed this Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Serum so much! I used it twice a week and had absolutely no irritation whatsoever, although my skin did feel a little dry. I really appreciated how gentle the formula was and was happy to see that it was safe to use around the eye area too, since most are not. The texture was creamy, very easy to apply and absorbed fully and quickly. I think this is also a great beginner friendly option because of how gentle it is, multipurpose because it's eye safe which also makes it an affordable option. Neutrogena has been killing it in their skincare lately and I can honestly say this works just as good as my regular and much pricier OTC retinol serums.

Whether you're just getting into retinol or you're experienced, this Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is amazing! I swear by retinol & have been using it in my nighttime routine for awhile. THIS really helps reverse & prevent new wrinkles from forming. It's lightweight & absorbs quick. It's extremely effective. In just a week my skin is visibly smoother & brighter. It lifts dark spots & really reduces the lines on my forehead and by my mouth. There's no scent or irritation. This is a premium product with an affordable price; it's truly such a great value! A little goes a long way. I'd definitely recommend & will be purchasing regularly.

There are a lot of positives about Neutrogena Retinol Renewal Serum. I like how is it is creamy and rubs on clear. It does not feel sticky at all. I like how this serum goes on smoothly. It dries quickly on my skin and leaves no residue. It smells good with no cloying scent. I have only used it for about ten days, so it is too soon to tell how well it will improve my fine lines and wrinkles, but I do like the product a lot.
Love this serum! My skin looks smoother and more youthful. I use it nightly, no irritation, and it hasn't caused any breakouts. For the price, you can't beat the results!

I love this product! It is leaving my skin more radiant and youthful looking. My skin is smoother and more even. This serum has helped with the appearance of my fine lines also. It is definitely effective and I highly recommend!

This Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is gentle yet effective. I use this everyday as part of my evening skincare routine and it hasn't caused any irritation. It has a light pleasant scent. It absorbs into my skin quickly and has made my skin feel smoother and look plumper after just a short time using it. I like that it doesn't leave any sticky residue and feels lightweight on my skin. This is a great retinol serum for beginners.

I've been using the new Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum from Neutrogena to help reduce the fine lines and wrinkles on my face. I appreciate the rich and creamy texture of the serum. I have normal skin, and it absorbs beautifully without feeling greasy. The application process is simple; I use 4-5 drops daily on my face, eye area, and neck, ensuring my skin is cleansed beforehand. I find this cream to be very effective. I have noticed a difference in my skin, and my fines lines have diminished. I will continue to use this product. I also like the packaging. It's easy to use. There is a miled scent which I appreciate. Overall, an excellent product.

As I get a little older it's becoming more part of my routine to use a retinol product. This can get pricey so I was excited to try a more affordable option. I have been using this for a couple of weeks and feel like my skin is refreshed. It doesn't dry out my face and feels like it does give me a youthful glow!

I found this product to make my face feel wonderful. It didn't dry out my skin or cause flakiness. I already feel like it's producing results that make my skin smoother. I will continue to use this product.

avis.titre: Little tacky but does a great job!
avis.texte: My initial reaction to this serum was it smooths over the skin beautifully. I let it dry and then followed my regular skin care routine. I noticed at nighttime that it left my skin a little tacky feeling with my night time moisturizer if I applied it too quickly. I wish the dropper was a tad longer. When you dip it into the bottle to get your 4-5 drops, the dropper generally comes back with only 1.5-2 drops. This was a little annoying but the way I found to prevent this was to squeeze the dropper before I unscrewed the bottle. My skin feels so soft and luxurious, my eye lines appear to have relaxed a tiny bit over the last week. My forehead lines may need a little more time.

I love this serum! It applies smoothly and doesn't burn. It feels light on my skin without giving me that caked on feeling. I've used it consistently and my skin feels great. I would definitely recommend this serum everyone. I will be buying it regularly.
I enjoyed using this product because it was a gentle addition to my routine. I didn't have any sensitivity and it left my skin feeling smooth and not greasy.

Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum Is quick absorbing and layers very well with my other skin care products. I love the scent and how it instantly leaves my skin looking smoother. It feels lightweight and doesn't irritate my face at all. I am very excited to see the long-term effects!

I truly have enjoyed using Neutrogena's rapid wrinkle repair retinol renewal serum. I have noticed a difference in my face. My skin is smoother and the lines have diminished. The texture and firmness has vastly improved. I highly recommend this product.

avis.titre: Renew The Look Of Your Skin
avis.texte: The Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum by Neutrogena is a serum that is formulated to combating the signs of aging. It targets not just wrinkles but pores, texture, and the firmness of my skin. I like that this serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly into my skin without leaving any greasy residue behind. It's best to use this product daily while applying to your face, eye, and neck. After using this serum for a short while I have noticed an amazing difference in how my skin looks and feels. Fine lines were visibly reduced and my complexion looks more plump and radiant.

This product was easy to apply. It did make my skin extremely dry, which it did state could. I cut back to using every other night as my skin did start to flake. I don't really know if I see a real difference, outside if the dryness. I'm a lover of Neutrogena products, just not this one.

I have loved using this serum with my skincare routine. The serum is lightweight and absorbs into my skin nicely. Doesn't leave any weird or sticky residue. My skin appears smoother and brighter after a few uses. I really like using this and will continue.

This Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum has such a great texture. Its not at all sticky and it's not super aquatic thin either. There is no residue left behind. Instantly after applying my skin feels smooth and looks more radiant.

I have really enjoyed using this product. It's very gentle and can even be used around the eyes without irritation! I am able to use this multiple times a week without issue which is great for my sensitive skin.

I have been using this Neutrogena Retinol Renewal Serum for a couple of weeks now and I love it. It has a lightweight and smooth texture. It comes with a dropper which makes it easy to apply. I love the fact that it absorbs fast and is non-greasy. It helps with my fine lines and wrinkles. It is also gentle and non-irritating to my skin. I will continue using it to get better results.

I like this product. First I would say it's more of a light lotion as then a serum. I've been using it for more than a week. I ve already noticed a difference. My skin seems a bight brighter and the fine lines around my mouth and by the eyes have become less noticeable. My skin also seems younger, less tired and smoother. Will definitely continue to use it in the future.

I have been using the serum for the past week, and I am pleasantly pleased with the results. I see some visible reduction in my fine lines, and I will admit at almost 80 it is hard to do that. I also appreciate how large the bottle is and it is refreshing that this will last me longer than one month.

I've tried a few retinol products over the years & I truly like this product. The packaging has a dropper and distributes an adequate amount of serum for my face and neck. The serum itself is white which is different than most other brands ive tried, however, it applies and rubs in clear. It did not cause any skin irritation like some retinol treatments or retinoids. I usually use this at night followed by a facial cream but not always. Sometimes, I've used it on its own and my skin still felt soft and moisturized. It has a fragrance but I don't think it is overwhelming. I always use sunscreen in the morning or when I'm exposed to the sun since retinols can increase skin sensitivity to the sun. Overall, I like this serum a lot and enjoy that it's cost effective, easy to find, and works well. My skin has a glow to it and while I can still see signs of previous hyperpigmentation and a few small wrinkles, it looks great in person. I recommend this product.
Amazing serum. Nice light fragrance, goes on smoothly, feels refreshing, and no oily residue. My skin feels smooth and I had no adverse effects or reaction. I recommend this product!

I have been using Tretinoin for a couple years but have been out of my prescription this year, so I was excited to try this Neutrogena serum because I had heard great things. Once you've used Tret, you know whether or not an OTC retinoid is good or not. You can just feel it. And let me say, this stuff packs a punch! It's a milky serum, so it glides on the skin beautifully & and soaks in quickly. I let it dry for about 20 minutes before adding my moisturizer. My skin looks so alive the next morning! My only con is that this is fragranced, but not too strong & dissipates pretty quickly. If you're looking to try retinol for the first time, I really recommend giving Neutrogena a try!

avis.titre: I like how this smells, plus it works
avis.texte: I received this product complimentary from Home Testers Club for my honest opinion. I love this product. It makes my skin soft and hydrated, and it smells good. I've been using Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum for several weeks now, and my skin looks, and feels better. I've noticed my skin is plumper with fewer lines and wrinkles after using it twice a day. It doesn't take much, just a little bit goes a long way, and soaks right in. It doesn't just sit on top of my skin, feel heavy, or cause any irritation. I definitely recommend it.

This Neutrogena serum comes in a high quality and heavy bottle with a dropper type of dispensing. Itbwas easy to use the dropper to get the right amount of serum for the face. I used a drop on each cheek amd then blended in. The serum blended smoothly and did not take long to absorb. The Retinol did not have a negative effect on my skin, nor did I experience any sensitivity to the serum. There was a pleasant scent to the serum, but nothing overpowering or heavy. The skin on my face looked radiant and is starting to have a much smoother look and feel. It is hard to capture the difference in a photo, but I can feel a difference. I still feel smooth skin even after waking up in the morning. I have been using the serum morning and night with no issues. Looking forward to continued use to see if it helps diminish fine lines and wrinkles.

I'm very impressed the beginning results from using the Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum by Neutrogena. I've been applying before bed time for over a week now, and my face feels firmer without feeling tight. The wrinkles on my forehead aren't as defined as before I started using. The formula is lightweight, drys instantly and I love how it absorbs nicely. It has a light subtle scent, and doesn't dry or irritate my skin. It's not sticky or greasy and goes on smoothly. The packaging is great, with an easy to use dropper. A little bit goes a long way, with one drop covering one side of my face. This small bottle is packed with super ingredients of carnosine, soothing complex with Retinol being the plus. This product should be used with an SPF if apply during the day, and it may also cause a tingle sensation at first use. I will continue to use, and I'm excited to see the end results. I highly recommend!!

This product is absolutely AMAZING! it is VERY hydrating, smooth and silky! I have noticed change of wrinkles disappearing, the scent smells soooo good and it's light weight and you can wear it anytime and with your skincare routine
I really enjoyed using this serum - nit went on my skin smooth and light, I beleive my dark spots are starting to lighten and I feel more confident in my skin

I thought this retinol serum worked quickly and well. I noticed a difference in my skin in just a few minutes after the first time using it. I thought it added moisture instantly while firming and tightening.

I really enjoy Neutrogena face products and the Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Serum is a great example of affordability that delivers great results. The serum is lightweight, smooth, and absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky feeling on my skin. Being a retinol-based product, I would recommend people who have never used one before to start gradually introducing it to their routine. I personally never had any issues with retinol. In my opinion, definitely worth the investment if you want real results and positive effects for your skin. I received this item for free from Home Tester Club in exchange for an honest review.

avis.titre: Definite must for visible signs of aging
avis.texte: I am pleasantly surprised to see some improvement in the fine lines on my face. This retinol product did not dry out my skin or cause any adverse reactions like other ones that I've tried. I've used twice a day on my face with no issues. Remember to wear sunscreen with retinol products! I would definitely recommend this product!

The Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is excellent for my combination skin. I have noticeable wrinkles and fine lines and this product feels amazing over the skin as it helps in diminishing them plus helps my skin heal from sunspots. I live the formula and how elegant the product is with readable clear instructions in usage. The formula glides easily into skin and the skin feels amazing even after the first usage. The continued use of this product has proven effective over my skin as it soothes it and provides excellent results.

This product has taken years off my age. My skin looks healthier and almost just as good as it did in my 30's! No one ever believes me when I tell them I'm 60 a grandmother of 9 with my oldest grandchild being 21 1/2 yrs old!

Neutrogena delivered again! This is great product for middle aged women. My skin feels much better and more smoother. I can actually see the difference in my lines and my texture. Absolutely love this product and highly recommend it.

I have fine lines on my forehead don't drive me nuts. I used the Neutrogena rapid wrinkle repair retinol renewal serum for two weeks and have seen a small difference. I will keep using it and believe I will get the results. I'm looking for within a month. I would recommend it for fine lines.

I love this product! Neutrogena makes such awesome skin products. I love how this one absorbs into my skin. It's not greasy or heavy. It's not overly fragranced either. The applicator also makes it so easy to use!

Excited for this product and its fast results! Cannot wait to see what happens with longer use. Product has a wonderful, light scent and does not leave residue or sticky feeling after use. So in love with this product.

I received this product for free to sample in exchange for my honest review. This Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Retinol Renewal Serum is amazing! You really can see the difference rapidly as the name applies. After using for just one week I could see a noticeable difference in my skin. I love that it doesn't dry out my skin either and just makes it looks more youthful overall. I highly recommend this product!

The neutrogena retinol serum is extremely lightweight and fast absorbing. It made my skin feel refreshed and hydrated specially when I applied it in the mornings. I did not feel any irritation. This serum exceeded my expectations, I could see see and feel results just after a few applications.

I really like this rapid Wei Joe repair retinol renewal serum. It went on nicely. It was lightweight and not greasy. It dried like I had nothing on my face. After many uses it made my face feel more hydrated and look fresh. Overall my skin felt healthier and I will continue to use it.

Just like anything with skincare you need more than 7 days to see any visible results but so far, so good. Retinol is an important step in a skincare routine for cell rejuvenation and turnover. This is middle of the road potency OTC product (stronger usually need a script). It's a good beginner retinol with no irritation that drinks into the skin well. I personally don't have sensitive skin for full disclosure. Mild enough to use daily but make sure you always use a sunscreen with any retinol product.

I have a dry mature skin, and have wrinkles and find lines around my eyes and mouth. I tried this serum for a week, but I don't see any significant changes so far. I like this serum a lot though. It's a beginner friendly retinol. It's lightweight and sink into skin quickly. Very gentle. My skin is not at the best right now, but I don't get any irritation. There is almost no scent. It was an easy addition to my evening skincare routine. I plan to continue using it until I finish the bottle. I'm looking forward to seeing the results.

This lightweight retinol serum has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. I've been using it each morning and it hasn't caused any redness or sensitivity to my sensitive-prone skin. I've noticed that my skin feels smoother, the fine lines around my eyes have decreased, and my skin now has a beautiful glow.

I received this product free in exchange for an honest review. I really like this serum. I used it 3 days in a row without irritation. I recommend skipping days if new to retinol, but this is very gentle on the skin. It has a nice clean scent, and it feels fabulous. I think I really did notice a difference in the fine lines. My skin felt very smooth. I will continue to use this product and I would consider purchasing in the future.
